description: This file defines the SubpanelQuickCreate class responsible for handling the quick create form in a subpanel within the SuiteCRM framework. It manages view setup, module view definitions, and display logic for quick creation of records.

classes.name: SubpanelQuickCreate
classes.description: A class for managing the quick create form in a subpanel, including view setup, module definition retrieval, and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the quick create subpanel, sets up the edit view, retrieves module view definitions, and optionally processes the form display.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the processing and display of the quick create form.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Instantiates and returns an EditView object.

methods.name: getModuleViewDefsSourceFile
methods.description: Determines the most appropriate view definitions file for the given module and view type.
